meta.superposition_invariant: Text is canonical. Emoji is render-only. If divergence occurs → text wins.
meta.discipline: emoji = epistemic label, never decoration. Agent shall not sprinkle emoji without label meaning.
meta.anti_pattern: sprinkle emoji as vibe without epistemic label reference

OBS.name: Observation
OBS.rule: Directly observed reality. Live probe, sensor reading, direct witness.

DER.name: Derived
DER.rule: Computed from observations. Entails chain of reasoning from OBS inputs.

INT.name: Interpretation
INT.rule: Reasoned judgment from evidence. Expert assessment, geological interpretation.

SPEC.name: Speculation
SPEC.rule: Active hypothesis. Unverified, hypothetical. Explicitly low confidence. Do not bet on this without further evidence.

CLAIM.name: Claim
CLAIM.rule: Asserted, evidence pending. Requires verification before use.

PLAUSIBLE.name: Plausible
PLAUSIBLE.rule: Reasonable, unverified. Consistent but not confirmed.

UNKNOWN.name: Unknown
UNKNOWN.rule: Genuinely unknown. This is an honest admission of ignorance.

SEAL.rule: Proceed — constitutional. All gates passed. Action is authorized.

HOLD.rule: Pause — need more evidence or human sovereign decision. Do not proceed.

SABAR.rule: Wait — not urgent, revisit later. Do not escalate.

EXE.name: ACT Execution Receipt
EXE.rule: Task completed. Terminal output per Hermes Output Contract. Direct map to ACT execution actuator.

EXE_PARTIAL.name: Execution Partial
EXE_PARTIAL.rule: Task in progress. Checkpoint receipt, not terminal.

DS_OK.rule: ΔS ≤ 0. Entropy stable or decreasing. System is healthy.

DS_WARN.rule: ΔS > 0.5. Entropy rising. Action needed before further mutation.

DS_CRIT.rule: ΔS > 0.8. Critical entropy. HOLD all mutation until resolved.

G_PASS.rule: G ≥ 0.80. F8 GENIUS gate passed. Action is sound.

G_FAIL.rule: G < 0.80. F8 GENIUS gate failed. Action needs redesign.

E19.name: The Observer Must Have an Observer
